# Modal

```tsx
import { Modal, ModalTrigger, ModalClose, ModalPortal, ModalOverlay, ModalContent, ModalHeader, ModalTitle, ModalBody, ModalDescription, ModalFooter } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para interromper momentaneamente a interação com o restante da tela, voltando a atenção da pessoa usuária para uma informação importante.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Modal {...args}>
  <ModalTrigger render={<Button variant="secondary" />}>
    Open modal
  </ModalTrigger>
  <ModalContent>
    <ModalHeader showCloseButton={showCloseButton}>
      <ModalTitle>{title}</ModalTitle>
    </ModalHeader>
    <ModalBody>
      {content === "text" ? (
        <ModalDescription render={<div />}>
          {Array.from({ length: repeat }, (_, index) => (
            <p key={index} className="not-first:mt-4">
              {description}
            </p>
          ))}
        </ModalDescription>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {Array.from({ length: repeat * 2 }, (_, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Label
                htmlFor={`story-modal-field-${index}`}
                label={`Field ${index + 1}`}
              />
              <InputText id={`story-modal-field-${index}`} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </ModalBody>
    {showFooter && (
      <ModalFooter>
        {actions >= 3 && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            danger={destructive === "ghost"}
            className="mr-auto"
          >
            Action 3
          </Button>
        )}
        {actions >= 2 && <Button variant="secondary">Action 2</Button>}
        <Button danger={destructive === "primary"}>Action 1</Button>
      </ModalFooter>
    )}
  </ModalContent>
</Modal>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Modal: a centered 496px card with Header (Title + close), a scrolling Body and an optional Footer (.Actions Footer). Content=Text puts a ModalDescription in the Body; Content=Custom puts any content (the Slot).

## Rules

- Import `Modal` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
